in_sanskrit.name: Muniyandi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wisdom
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Muniyandi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Muniyandi is a Tamil name for the Hindu god of wisdom and learning. It is derived from the word 'muni', which means 'sage' or 'wise one'. Muniyandi is revered as the patron of scholars, students, and seekers of knowledge. He is also believed to bestow the qualities of wisdom, intelligence, and knowledge upon those who invoke him.
